entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk ruin diver who survives the fall of Sea Gate and helps Kiora recover her lost bident from a Kozilek-ravaged cave network.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker with a broken leg and shattered confidence after Kozilek killed Lorthos and she lost the bident, determined to recover it.

entities.name: Zahr Gada
entities.description: An explorer who once compared maps with Jori and told her of the goblin-inhabited cave network.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker whose defense at Sea Gate failed against Kozilek.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped build the failed hedron prison.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped build the failed hedron prison.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A commander whose forces were scattered or killed.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who emerged from beneath the ground, broke Ulamog's prison and Sea Gate, and reshaped the caves with his mark.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan freed from the hedron prison.

entities.name: Lorthos
entities.description: Kiora's greatest champion of the sea, broken by Kozilek.

entities.name: Kozilek's spawn
entities.description: Eldrazi with black glass shards that fill the caves, including a dead heap discarded in a chamber.

entities.name: Eyeless goblins
entities.description: Eyeless cave goblins who see with sound, one of whom carries off the bident.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: The god's weapon Kiora lost when Kozilek attacked and which she recovers with Jori's help.

entities.name: Hedron prison
entities.description: The prison of hedrons that held Ulamog and now lies at the bottom of the sea.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city whose wall and lighthouse were toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight.

entities.name: Cave network
entities.description: A subterranean network near Sea Gate, once home to goblins, reshaped by Kozilek and visited by Jori and Kiora.

entities.name: Yawning Chasm
entities.description: A chasm off the coast of Ondu, home of the horned rift octopus.

entities.name: Old Zulaport
entities.description: A former coastal port where Jori learned to set bones.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A coast near the Yawning Chasm.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being ruined by two titans.

events.summary: Jori En wakes in the murky water beneath Sea Gate amid the carcasses of the sea's creatures, including a dead horned rift octopus.
Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
events.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

events.summary: Jori hears a cry for help and finds Kiora with a compound leg fracture, who says Cosi won and the bident is gone.
Jori sets and splints Kiora's leg, and green energy heals the wound.
events.quote: a cluster of green motes fluttered to life around the wound.

events.summary: Kiora asks Jori's help to recover the bident, which she calls their only hope, and Jori agrees to show her the way.
events.quote: Now we just need to recover the bident.

events.summary: Following a strange current, Jori and Kiora swim into a cliff and are dragged through a rift, a Kozilek spawn guarding the way until the crevasse collapses on it.
events.quote: All at once, the crevasse collapsed in on itself and the Eldrazi

events.summary: In Kozilek's reshaped caves, Kiora senses the bident beyond a ravine.
Jori guides a panicking Kiora through a very narrow tunnel as the bident moves ahead.
events.quote: Keep your eyes on me, Kiora.

events.summary: Jori finds a chamber piled with dead Kozilek spawn and a shaft leading up.
events.quote: But the Eldrazi were not moving. They were all dead.

events.summary: Eyeless goblins attack Jori; she kills one and stuns the others by amplifying sound.
Jori chases the goblin carrying the bident, falls with it into a chasm, breaking ribs, and takes the bident.
Kiora reclaims the bident and uses it to flood the caves, carrying both merfolk out on a torrent.
events.quote: Kiora had compelled the ocean to strip the land away.

relations.note: Jori helps Kiora recover the bident.
relations.quote: she pressed the god-weapon into Kiora's hand, and smiled.
the titan halted them and broke their greatest champion.

relations.note: Kiora says Kozilek won and wants to recover the bident to oppose him.

relations.quote: For something to have the power to reshape the environment like this
He freed his brother, and now they are on the loose.
